intro: Two quick questions and you're in.

questions.label: Your name, as neighbours will see it
questions.help: We use real names in chat, so people know who they're talking to. First name and last initial is fine.

questions.label: How would you like to help?
questions.help: Pick any. You can change this later.

questions.label: Your neighbourhood (optional)
questions.help: Just the area, like Seabright or Live Oak, so we can connect you with people nearby.
